title: Asset Intake Wizard, Map Composer, Palette & Workbench
start_authority: Owner Continue on 2026-08-26 America/Chicago freshly verified canonical AIOC head 0c231bfc74909960692863d890cead0301deba14 and application head c7aeff6470199366ba033cce892e6816f9253d8a, re-read completed MAI-01..07 evidence and resolved the bounded asset-intake wizard, composer, palette and workbench contract before implementation.
objective: Implement a provider-neutral, deterministic and reversible presentation-authoring workbench that stages already supplied/catalogued assets, exposes source/license/provenance/import/resolver evidence, composes MAI presentation records and supports manual/placeholder/unresolved authoring outcomes without creating World, Scene, Visibility, Combat, provenance-publication or runtime integration truth.

intake_wizard.source_scope: Only user-supplied or already-catalogued source/package/asset evidence and completed MAI-06 import results may enter the wizard. No provider network ingestion, download, purchase, authentication, scraping, payment or automatic acquisition is authorized.
intake_wizard.validation_rule: Required source/checksum/license/provenance/import evidence remains explicit. Unsupported, malformed, denied, unknown or unverified inputs produce stable findings and cannot be silently normalized into allowed assets.
intake_wizard.acceptance_rule: Acceptance stages an asset/package reference for authoring only; it does not publish, grant permission, mutate an owner domain or make a provider schema canonical.

palette.input: MAI-07 semantic requirement, candidate evidence and resolver outcomes over the staged catalog.
palette.selection_rule: Automatic selectable candidates must remain MAI-07 eligible. Denied, unknown, incompatible and unverified candidates remain visible evidence but cannot become allowed through the palette.
palette.manual_rule: Manual assignment/override is first-class. A manually requested ineligible or missing asset stays explicitly rejected/visibly-unresolved with diagnostics rather than silently falling back.
palette.placeholder_rule: Approved placeholder remains an explicit caller/author choice, must itself be permitted under existing evidence and is never silently substituted.

consumes: MAI-07 semantic requirements, eligibility evidence, diagnostics and selected asset references
composer.reversibility_rule: Every bounded authoring operation changes draft presentation state only and must be reversible without mutating source evidence or owner-domain state.
composer.owner_rule: Composer output is authoring intent only. It cannot create or mutate canonical World/location/topology/navigation, runtime Scene placement/state, visibility/occlusion authorization, collision/cover/movement/combat/interaction state or D29 governed publication/provenance state.

workbench_state.identity: Stable draft/workbench ID plus explicit references to source/package/assets, semantic requirements, selected assignments, presentation layers/placeables and owner-domain references.
workbench_state.evidence: Retain ordered source/license/provenance/import/resolver diagnostics and references alongside draft choices; authoring choices never erase contradictory or rejected evidence.
workbench_state.save_boundary: Save/export produces a deterministic MAI-08 draft snapshot/receipt suitable for later MAI-09 integration, not a runtime Scene/World mutation and not a governed D29 publication event.
workbench_state.determinism: Canonical draft serialization and receipt must be independent of input collection ordering and platform, using stable IDs and ordered evidence/diagnostics.
workbench_state.persistence_rule: The governed start demonstrates no required durable database schema delta. Migration 0022 remains unreserved; implementation must stay in contract/client-local/test fixture boundaries unless a concrete persistence requirement is separately demonstrated and governed.

owner_boundaries.provenance: D29 authoring-provenance retains governed publication/provenance workflow; MAI-08 only carries evidence references in draft state.
owner_boundaries.scene: Scene/Tabletop retains runtime scene/layer/object placement, mutation and active state.
owner_boundaries.visibility: Visibility/Permissions retains audience visibility, hidden state, occlusion authorization and line-of-sight.
owner_boundaries.gameplay: Combat/Exploration retains collision, cover, movement, interaction, triggers, portals and gameplay consequences.
owner_boundaries.successor: MAI-09 is the first tranche allowed to integrate MAI draft outputs with owner-domain/runtime systems and remains unauthorized here.

validation_contract.focused: Add a focused MAI-08 verifier plus client typecheck/integration regression exercising intake findings, evidence-aware palette behavior, reversible draft composition, manual/placeholder/unresolved outcomes and deterministic receipt stability.
validation_contract.predecessors: Preserve MAI-07..01 regressions and MIB-11/D18 plus relevant Scene/Visibility/Combat/D29 owner-boundary checks.
validation_contract.final_gate: Exact candidate head must pass Repository Health, self-hosted Linux and Windows Validation Core, deterministic cross-platform comparison and applicable focused/predecessor/owner regressions before merge.

preserved_boundaries: no vendor/editor/provider becomes canonical Multiversal map truth
no asset pack is assumed complete
semantic requirements remain separate from selected/available art
permissions and semantic compatibility are not inferred
manual assignment, approved-placeholder and visibly-unresolved outcomes remain first-class and reversible
intake is limited to supplied/catalogued evidence with no automatic provider acquisition/download/payment/authentication/scraping
composer/workbench state is presentation-authoring draft state only
MIB-11/D18, D29, Scene/Tabletop, Visibility/Permissions and Combat/Exploration retain owner truth
migration 0022 remains unreserved absent demonstrated durable schema delta
no real-money commerce, tester distribution, release/deployment or provider/payment activation
nonauthorization: migration 0022 without separately demonstrated and governed persistence delta
